fields.label: Projects folder
fields.help: Where your projects live in the house, like ~/code. A task names a folder under it.

fields.label: Model
fields.help: Like sonnet, opus or a full model name. Empty: Claude Code's own choice.

fields.label: Let tasks run commands
fields.help: Off: a task only reads and edits files, unless you say --shell.

fields.label: Budget per run (dollars)
fields.help: A run stops when it would cost more. Counts API prices, also on a plan.

fields.label: Minutes in the foreground
fields.help: A run you wait for stops after this long. Long tasks go in the background with start.
